title: No Poverty
description: End poverty in all its forms everywhere. Includes eradicating extreme poverty, implementing social protection systems, ensuring equal rights to economic resources, and building resilience of the poor against climate disasters.

title: Zero Hunger
description: End hunger, achieve food security and improved nutrition, and promote sustainable agriculture. Covers ending malnutrition, doubling agricultural productivity, sustainable food production, and seed banks.

title: Good Health and Well-Being
description: Ensure healthy lives and promote well-being for all at all ages. Covers reducing maternal and child mortality, fighting communicable diseases, mental health, and access to essential medicines.

title: Quality Education
description: Ensure inclusive and equitable quality education and promote lifelong learning opportunities for all. Covers free primary education, early childhood development, technical skills, and literacy.

title: Gender Equality
description: Achieve gender equality and empower all women and girls. Includes ending discrimination, violence against women, equal participation in leadership, and reproductive rights.

title: Clean Water and Sanitation
description: Ensure availability and sustainable management of water and sanitation for all. Covers safe drinking water, adequate sanitation, wastewater treatment, and water-use efficiency.

title: Affordable and Clean Energy
description: Ensure access to affordable, reliable, sustainable, and modern energy for all. Covers electricity access, renewable energy share, and energy efficiency improvements.

title: Decent Work and Economic Growth
description: Promote sustained, inclusive and sustainable economic growth, full and productive employment, and decent work for all. Covers job creation, labor rights, and youth employment.

title: Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure
description: Build resilient infrastructure, promote inclusive and sustainable industrialization, and foster innovation. Covers transport, R&D, technology, and internet access.

title: Reduced Inequalities
description: Reduce inequality within and among countries. Covers income growth of bottom 40%, social/economic/political inclusion, and migration policies.

title: Sustainable Cities and Communities
description: Make cities and human settlements inclusive, safe, resilient, and sustainable. Covers housing, transport, urbanization, cultural heritage, and disaster resilience.

title: Responsible Consumption and Production
description: Ensure sustainable consumption and production patterns. Covers resource efficiency, waste reduction, recycling, and sustainable corporate practices.

title: Climate Action
description: Take urgent action to combat climate change and its impacts. Covers climate resilience, adaptation, mitigation, and climate education.

title: Life Below Water
description: Conserve and sustainably use the oceans, seas, and marine resources. Covers marine pollution, overfishing, ocean acidification, and marine protected areas.

title: Life on Land
description: Protect, restore, and promote sustainable use of terrestrial ecosystems. Covers forests, biodiversity, land degradation, and wildlife conservation.

title: Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
description: Promote peaceful and inclusive societies, provide access to justice, and build effective, accountable institutions. Covers violence, corruption, rule of law.

title: Partnerships for the Goals
description: Strengthen the means of implementation and revitalize global partnerships for sustainable development. Covers finance, technology, trade, capacity building.
